answer: Persistent spend history. Each identity carries a violet ledger of verified payments, and an operator’s score is the minimum across all wallets it controls. Like light through a prism, shared funding sources split into one visible operator profile. An attacker must rebuild that history per clone at full cost, paying real fees with no reuse.
